event_chain.summary: DragonForce leak-site listing with ransom deadline

summary: On April 27, 2026 the DragonForce ransomware group listed Australian gelato franchisor Gelatissimo on its leak site, claiming to have stolen 352.42 GB of data and setting a deadline of under five days. Sample screenshots showed employee names and pay details, partial tax file numbers, a visa application with passport details, a workplace incident report, a bank transfer receipt and a corporate bank statement, plus contact details of the CEO and CFO. Gelatissimo did not respond to questions.
